description: This file contains unit tests for decoding various WebSocket or IPC frames using JSON in a Swift project. It verifies decoding logic for different frame types including event, request, and unknown frame, by applying JSON decoding and assertions on the decoded objects.

classes.name: GatewayFrameDecodeTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple test methods to verify the decoding of GatewayFrame objects from JSON data.

methods.name: decodes event frame with any codable payload
methods.description: Test method that decodes a JSON string representing an event frame and verifies the contents of the decoded object.

methods.name: decodes request frame with nested params
methods.description: Test method that decodes a JSON string representing a request frame with nested parameters and verifies the contents.

methods.name: decodes unknown frame and preserves raw
methods.description: Test method that decodes a JSON string with an unknown frame type and verifies that the raw data is preserved.
